issue_context.title: Bug: Items from multiple columns are selected
issue_context.body:
### Description

If I have an item selected individually (first image) and then I make a multiple selection in the same folder, the previously selected item will result in a double selection (second image)

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/118266752/90ae406f-ad0a-4d1e-bf52-1f2a2ee3f984)

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/118266752/08f7f4ba-bafe-4466-9e12-4af22684ace4)




### Steps To Reproduce

1. Select a single item
2. make a multiple selection in the same folder

1. Select a single item
2. Hover over folder items
3. Previously selected single item will have double selection

### Requirements
- Close open folder if selecting multiple items in the parent folder

### Files Version

2.4.82.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.1702

### Log file

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/11543352/debug.log)
comments:
Steps To Reproduce

1. Select a single item

2. make a multiple selection in the same folder

OR

1. Select a single item

2. Hover over folder items

3. Previously selected single item will have double selection
Do you have the hover to selection option enabled?
occurs equally with the option on and off
@redhotideas thank you for reporting this issue, it'll be resolved in the upcoming v2.5 release.

review_comments: Alternatively, we can keep the last column open and only clear the selection so it's selected once.
I think the last column should be closed because it is impossible to tell which folder is open when multiple selections are made.
